desk:
**BLUF:** The community is focused on Ukrainian long-range strikes hitting Russian military-industrial targets and a sharp spike in Brent crude to $117 amid escalating maritime incidents in the Strait of Hormuz. The single most important thing is the confirmed Storm Shadow strike on Oryol’s Proton plant, seen as direct retaliation for Russian missile production.

## MAIN THREADS
### Ukrainian strikes on Russian targets
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2113666349113434371) reports a Storm Shadow cruise missile strike on Russia’s Proton plant in Oryol, an electronics producer for ballistic missiles, days after the UK supplied more missiles.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2113639098946867380) shows drone footage of a hit on Russia’s Federal Tax Service datacenter in Gorodets.
- Multiple accounts note these as part of ongoing Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian production and logistics.

### Oil price surge and Hormuz incidents
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113665617530061028) and [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2113661345199513700) both highlight Brent crude hitting $117/barrel, up 15% this month, driven by regional fighting and Iran-related fears.
- [@UK_MTO](https://x.com/UK_MTO/status/2113646703303868669) and [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113651876084260961) detail a tanker hit by an unknown projectile 7 nm northeast of Limah, Oman, with over 30 unreported incidents in three weeks.

### US domestic and Pentagon developments
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113660513657704865) covers the Pentagon’s new Technology Support Office for covert tech sabotage against adversaries, denied by officials.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113650107568533867) notes a US State Department security alert for protests in France ahead of potential unrest.

## CONTESTED
The claim of First Lady Melania Trump securing a localized ceasefire in Oleshky, Ukraine, appears only in [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113632441860583508) quoting its own earlier post and is presented with clear skepticism; no other accounts corroborate.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2113666352397615574) posts an image linked to the Oryol strike (unconfirmed details).  
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113660513657704865) details the $1.5B+ classified budget for the new Pentagon tech sabotage office (unconfirmed).  
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113650107568533867) flags the France protest alert tied to the NFL game in Paris (unconfirmed escalation risk).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts expect follow-on Ukrainian strikes on missile production sites and further unreported Hormuz incidents that could push oil higher. Watch for any official confirmation or denial of the Pentagon’s Technology Support Office and escalation signals around Iran.
